items.question: James earns $20 an hour while working at his main job.  He earns 20% less while working his second job.  He works 30 hours at his main job and half that much at his second job.  How much does he earn per week?

previous_f3_program: observe(at("james.main_job.earnings_rate", "current"), 20, "dollar_per_hour", source("James earns $20 an hour while working at his main job"))
percent_less(at("james.second_job.earnings_rate", "current"), at("james.main_job.earnings_rate", "current"), 20, source("He earns 20% less while working his second job"))
observe(at("james.main_job.work_duration", "week"), 30, "hour", source("He works 30 hours at his main job"))
fraction_of(at("james.second_job.work_duration", "week"), at("james.main_job.work_duration", "week"), 1, 2, source("half that much at his second job"))
query("value", at("james.earnings.total", "week"))

items.question: Alice has 20 quarters. She wants to exchange them for nickels and so she goes to the bank. After getting back from the bank, she discovers that 20% of the nickels are iron nickels worth $3 each. What is the total value of her money now?

Jackson wants to go on a shopping spree, so his mom says she will give him some spending money if he does extra chores. She promises $5 per hour spent on chores.  Jackson spends 2 hours vacuuming, and decides to do this twice. He also spends 0.5 hours washing dishes, and three times as long cleaning the bathroom.  How much spending money has Jackson earned?

previous_f3_program: observe(at("jackson.chores.pay_rate", "current"), 5, "dollar_per_hour", source("$5 per hour spent on chores"))
observe(at("jackson.chores.vacuuming.session_duration", "current"), 2, "hour", source("2 hours vacuuming"))
observe(at("jackson.chores.vacuuming.session_count", "current"), 2, "count", source("do this twice"))

product_relation(at("jackson.chores.vacuuming.total_duration", "current"), at("jackson.chores.vacuuming.session_duration", "current"), at("jackson.chores.vacuuming.session_count", "current"), source("spends 2 hours vacuuming, and decides to do this twice"))
observe(at("jackson.chores.dishwashing.duration", "current"), 0.5, "hour", source("0.5 hours washing dishes"))
multiple(at("jackson.chores.bathroom_cleaning.duration", "current"), at("jackson.chores.dishwashing.duration", "current"), 3, source("three times as long cleaning the bathroom"))
rate_relation(at("jackson.spending_money.earned", "current"), at("jackson.chores.pay_rate", "current"), at("jackson.chores.total_duration", "current"), source("$5 per hour spent on chores"))
query("value", at("jackson.spending_money.earned", "current"))

items.question: Jenna runs a wholesale business. She pays $3 for each widget and resells it for $8. Every month she has to pay $10,000 in rent, 20% of her total profit in taxes, and $2,500 each to four workers. If Jenna sells 5000 widgets one month, how much is her total profit or loss?

previous_f3_program: observe(at("jenna.widgets.purchase_price", "month"), 3, "dollar_per_widget", source("$3 for each widget"))
observe(at("jenna.widgets.resale_price", "month"), 8, "dollar_per_widget", source("resells it for $8"))
observe(at("jenna.business.rent", "month"), 10000, "dollar", source("$10,000 in rent"))
percent_of(at("jenna.business.taxes", "month"), at("jenna.business.total_profit", "month"), 20, source("20% of her total profit in taxes"))
observe(at("jenna.business.worker_pay_per_worker", "month"), 2500, "dollar_per_worker", source("$2,500 each to four workers"))
observe(at("jenna.business.worker_count", "month"), 4, "count", source("four workers"))

product_relation(at("jenna.business.total_worker_pay", "month"), at("jenna.business.worker_pay_per_worker", "month"), at("jenna.business.worker_count", "month"), source("$2,500 each to four workers"))
remove("widget_sales", "jenna", at("jenna.widgets.count", "current"), 5000, source("sells 5000 widgets one month"))
product_relation(at("jenna.business.widget_acquisition_cost", "month"), at("jenna.widgets.purchase_price", "month"), event_field("widget_sales", "quantity"), source("$3 for each widget"))
product_relation(at("jenna.business.widget_sales_revenue", "month"), at("jenna.widgets.resale_price", "month"), event_field("widget_sales", "quantity"), source("resells it for $8"))
query("value", at("jenna.business.total_profit", "month"))

items.question: In preparation for the church fundraiser, Julia bakes one less than 5 cakes per day for 6 days.  Unfortunately, every other day, Julia's brother, Clifford, sneaks into Julia's house and eats one of Julia's cakes.  At the end of 6 days, how many cakes does Julia have remaining?

previous_f3_program: collection("julia.cakes", "cake", "julia.house", source("sneaks into Julia's house and eats one of Julia's cakes"))
offset(at("julia.cakes.baking_rate", "preparation"), 5, -1, "cake_per_day", source("one less than 5 cakes per day"))
observe(at("fundraiser.preparation.duration", "preparation"), 6, "day", source("for 6 days"))

rate_relation(at("julia.cakes.baked.count", "end_of_6_days"), at("julia.cakes.baking_rate", "preparation"), at("fundraiser.preparation.duration", "preparation"), source("Julia bakes one less than 5 cakes per day for 6 days"))
produce("baking_over_six_days", "julia", at("julia.cakes.count", "current"), at("julia.cakes.baked.count", "end_of_6_days"), source("Julia bakes one less than 5 cakes per day for 6 days"))
fraction_of(at("clifford.cake_eating_days.duration", "preparation"), at("fundraiser.preparation.duration", "preparation"), 1, 2, source("every other day"))
observe(at("clifford.cake_eating.rate", "preparation"), 1, "cake_per_eating_day", source("every other day, Julia's brother, Clifford, sneaks into Julia's house and eats one of Julia's cakes"))

rate_relation(at("clifford.cakes.consumed.count", "end_of_6_days"), at("clifford.cake_eating.rate", "preparation"), at("clifford.cake_eating_days.duration", "preparation"), source("every other day, Julia's brother, Clifford, sneaks into Julia's house and eats one of Julia's cakes"))

consume("clifford_every_other_day", "clifford", at("julia.cakes.count", "current"), at("clifford.cakes.consumed.count", "end_of_6_days"), source("every other day, Julia's brother, Clifford, sneaks into Julia's house and eats one of Julia's cakes"))
query("remaining_count", "julia.cakes", "end_of_6_days")
